blocks.text: CITY OF ILAGAN, Isabela — After allegedly parking in a no-parking area, the husband of an Ilagan City councilor reportedly became furious and allegedly assaulted a traffic enforcer along a road in San Vicente village on Sept. 21. Bernardino Baldoz, 80, a former barangay chair, said he was managing traffic when he saw Policarpio Gaoiran, husband of Councilor Perlita Gangan-Gaoiran, park in the no-parking area. Baldoz said he politely asked Gaoiran to look for another place to park.
